description: A threshold shaper on the positive side of a signal: once the input plus BIAS rises past SET, the sample is replaced by the level AMT sets, and below that it passes straight through

params.text: Adds 0 to 5V to the input before it is compared with SET, and reaches the output no other way
Sets the level, 0 to 10V, that the input plus BIAS has to pass for the sample to be replaced
Sets the level a passing sample is replaced by, 0V fully left to 6V fully right

inputs.text: The signal to be processed, of which only the first channel is read
Replaces the SET knob with this voltage for as long as it is patched
Replaces the AMT knob for as long as it is patched: the size of the voltage, divided by 10 and multiplied by 6, becomes the replacement level
Replaces the BIAS knob with this voltage for as long as it is patched

outputs.text: The processed signal, always one channel

notes: each of the three CV jacks replaces its knob outright rather than adding to it, so patching one takes that knob out of use entirely
only the positive side is treated: a sample whose total stays below the threshold passes through untouched, and the negative half of a waveform is never touched at all
with AMT at zero a passing sample is set to 0.1V rather than to zero
the module browser calls this a wavefolder, but the code replaces the sample with a level rather than reflecting it back, so what comes out is a flat step rather than a fold

inputs.0:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the SET knob.
inputs.2:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the AMT knob.
inputs.3:
0 to 5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the BIAS knob.
